en: Proverbs 29

p.src: 1  He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.

en: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
u.src: 1  He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.

p.src: 2  When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.

en: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
u.src: 2  When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.

p.src: 3  Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

en: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
u.src: 3  Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

p.src: 4  The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.

en: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.
u.src: 4  The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.

p.src: 5  A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

en: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
u.src: 5  A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

p.src: 6  An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.

en: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.
u.src: 6  An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.

p.src: 7  The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.

en: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.
u.src: 7  The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.

p.src: 8  Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.

en: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.
u.src: 8  Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.

p.src: 9  If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

en: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.
u.src: 9  If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

p.src: 10  The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.

en: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.
u.src: 10  The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.

p.src: 11  A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

en: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.
u.src: 11  A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

p.src: 12  If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.

en: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.
u.src: 12  If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.

p.src: 13  The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.

en: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.
u.src: 13  The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.

p.src: 14  The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.

en: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.
u.src: 14  The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.

p.src: 15  The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.

en: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.
u.src: 15  The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.

p.src: 16  When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.

en: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
u.src: 16  When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.

p.src: 17  Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.

en: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.
u.src: 17  Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.

p.src: 18  Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.

en: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.
u.src: 18  Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.

p.src: 19  A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.

en: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.
u.src: 19  A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.

p.src: 20  Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

en: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
u.src: 20  Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

p.src: 21  He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.

en: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.
u.src: 21  He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.

p.src: 22  An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.

en: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.
u.src: 22  An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.

p.src: 23  A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.

en: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.
u.src: 23  A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.

p.src: 24  Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.

en: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.
u.src: 24  Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.

p.src: 25  The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.

en: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.
u.src: 25  The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.

p.src: 26  Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from the LORD.

en: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from the LORD.
u.src: 26  Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from the LORD.

p.src: 27  A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.

en: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
u.src: 27  A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
